policy: Private fieldwork preparation, not public parking listings or a commercial ranking. Every task remains unverified. No source coordinate is a confirmed entrance.
navigationPolicy: Links are constructed solely from permitted source coordinates, for navigation/search only. No Google content acquired.

questions.identity: Does this mapped object exist here, and what name/sign identifies it? Compare the source ID and neighboring possible matches; do not combine different floors or entrances by name alone.
questions.access: Can an ordinary visiting driver lawfully use it now? Record public/customer/resident/permit/employee conditions and the source of permission. Unknown remains unknown.
questions.operation: Is it operating at the observed date/time? Record closure, construction, obstruction or contradictory signs, without assuming a missing sign grants permission.
questions.entrance: Where is the permitted vehicle entrance and safe approach? Record a separately observed entrance coordinate and direction. The research anchor is not an entrance.
questions.rates: With permission, record the actual posted rate, currency, duration, grace/overnight/event rules and observed timestamp. If no rate is confirmed, leave it unknown.
questions.hours: What operating and entry/exit hours are actually posted or confirmed by an authorized operator? Record exceptions and the checked fact, not a general 24/7 assumption.
questions.evidence: Record dated sign/operator/observation evidence and limitations. Photograph only where permitted; avoid people, plates and private information.
questions.parent: Which physical facility owns this entrance or bay? Check signage, floor/bay identifier and visitor eligibility; a geometric parent proposal is not confirmation.
questions.street: Confirm the exact block, side, signs, loading/fire/driveway restrictions, schedules and applicable current ordinance. Do not park to test uncertain legality.
questions.morato: If within the Scout Rallos–Don A. Roces corridor, confirm the current IRR/implementation phase and Sunday 06:00–10:00 restrictions. SP-3345-S-2024 phases first-Sunday/every-other-Sunday/full implementation; do not assume every Sunday is closed.
questions.category: Is this a surface lot, parking structure, mall/commercial facility or another use? Record independent signs/operator evidence and exact scope. A name alone does not prove mall membership.
questions.conflict: Compare both conflicting source locations from the review ledger. Is this a relocation, different branch, entrance/floor, outdated provider position or an erroneous/nonparking listing? Do not choose or average a location without evidence.

visitPeriods.poblacion: Weeknight 18:00–21:00, contrasted with Friday/Saturday evening; proposed sampling, not confirmed business hours.
visitPeriods.cubao: Ordinary retail period and a documented Coliseum event or weekend/payday period; confirm the actual event calendar.
visitPeriods.bgc: Weekday 08:00–10:00 office arrivals and an evening retail/dining period.
visitPeriods.tomas-morato: Weeknight dining period plus a Sunday 06:00–10:00 corridor/signage observation, after checking the implemented ordinance phase.
visitPeriods.binondo: Weekday midday errands and a contrasting weekend period; distinguish loading from parking.
visitPeriods.makati-cbd: Weekday office-arrival period and a contrasting evening or weekend retail period.
visitPeriods.ortigas: Weekday office-arrival period and a contrasting weekend mall period; check the responsible LGU.
visitPeriods.moa: Ordinary retail period and a separately documented event period.
visitPeriods.north-edsa: Weekday commuting/office period and a contrasting weekend retail period.
visitPeriods.alabang: Weekday office period and a contrasting weekend retail period.
visitPeriods.maginhawa: Weeknight and weekend dining periods; account for resident access and current curb rules.
visitPeriods.other-ncr: Two predeclared contrasting ordinary/peak periods based on locally confirmed land use; no peak demand inferred from source counts.

permissionInstructions.restricted: Do not enter; observe only from a lawful public place. Owner/operator authorization is required before entry, photography or any partner conversation.
permissionInstructions.ordinary: Use only lawfully accessible approaches; obtain operator permission before entering restricted areas, photographing where restricted, or discussing inventory/partnerships.

readinessImpacts.street: Resolves block/side/access evidence only after human legal review; no automatic publication.
readinessImpacts.child: Can establish parent identity and a permitted entrance/bay; does not create a separate facility or capacity claim.
readinessImpacts.facility: Can resolve physical identity, visitor-access and operating facts for a facility; separate human license/publication approval remains required.
